notes.title: RXE Version 0.1.2 Released
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Version 0.1.2 of RXE is now live. Here are some of the more significant changes:


Improved wheels + physics handling
Got Steam achievements and stats working properly
UI/controls improvements for Linux
Bugfixes


Some of my plans for the near future include adding control flow (if/while/for) programming stuff, sensors (gyroscope/accelerometer?), and localization (mit Deutsch und Englisch).

Of course, community feedback is welcome, and I've taken into account what I've heard so far. Version 0.2.0 should be coming out within the next few weeks, and at that point I'll start reaching out and trying to spread word about the game. We have big plans for RXE, and I hope to detail those in a post sometime soon.

-Bryce (PlayerBuce)

notes.title: RXE Version 0.1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

RXE Version 0.1.1 has been released. This update has a long, long list of changes, but here are some of the most important/noteworthy:

- Wheel physics/interface improvements.
- Visual/UI changes.
- 2 new challenge levels.
- Multiplayer improvements.
- Lots and lots of bugfixes and gameplay tweaks.

Stay tuned for future updates!
-Bryce Messmann (PlayerBuce)

notes.title: RXE Version 0.1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

RXE has officially entered Early Access! Version 0.1.0 is the initial release version, with some singleplayer levels as well as a singleplayer/multiplayer sandbox mode.

We will be updating RXE as often as possible with small bugfixes. If you find any bugs, shoot us an email at bug@bucestudios.com and we can start working on it.

In the meantime, here are some other links:
